newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF says shareholders to hold on to stakes.
newsitem.headline: BHF says shareholders to hold on to stakes.

text.p: BHF-Bank AG, whose shares on Friday surged after a newspaper report that Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG was interested in acquiring it, said on Friday that its major shareholders were committed to holding on to their stakes in the bank.

A spokeswoman for BHF-Bank reiterated remarks made by chief executive Ernst Michel Kruse, who told the annual shareholders' meeting on Tuesday that the bank's major shareholders did not plan to sell their shares.

"Mr Kruse said clearly that the bank wanted to increase its earnings and is working on that and that its major shareholders stand by their shareholdings," the spokeswoman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
